== Channeling in Steddings ==
I went ahead and updated the channeling bit based on info from Gathering Storm.  Rand seems pretty damn confident that he could form weaves outside Far Madding that would affect inside (he was standing outside at the time).  But since it's mentioned multiple times that Waygates were outside steddings because they couldn't be made inside indicates that weaves couldn't pass through the barrier (assuming AoL Aes Sedai would know).  Far Madding's ter'angreal seems to be an inferior copy of the effect.  Given the apparent rarity of wells in "modern" times, they probably never noticed that loophole. --[[User:GaidinBDJ|GaidinBDJ]] 02:08, August 11, 2010 (UTC)
